ideas.pitch: A compact agricultural rover that navigates crop rows, scans leaf health using computer vision, and measures soil moisture and NPK levels in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: AgriTech: Technology for modern agriculture and farming
ideas.title: AgriSense: Autonomous Crop Disease and Soil Nutrient Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a custom physical mechanical build with real-time sensor data, following the winning pattern of a physical robot that performs well in a live demonstration.

ideas.pitch: A low-power ultrasonic sensor and tilt-monitoring node placed inside city drainage manholes to prevent urban flooding by predicting blockages.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart City & Civic Tech: Urban infrastructure and governance solutions
ideas.title: SmartDrain: IoT Urban Waterlogging and Silt Monitoring Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a massive urban civic problem with an actual working circuit prototype that municipal judges can see and interact with live on the table.

ideas.pitch: A portable mesh communication device for first responders that relays voice packets and GPS coordinates without cellular infrastructure.
ideas.problem_statement: IoT – Connected devices and intelligent systems
ideas.title: AeroMesh: LoRa-Based Off-Grid Emergency Comms Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages off-grid radio mesh networking, echoing the winning strategy of hardware solutions that prove resilience and functionality in offline environments.

ideas.pitch: A smart dustbin retrofit featuring a servo-actuated sorting flap driven by a lightweight image classification model running on an edge microcontroller.
ideas.title: EcoBin: Edge-AI Automated Waste Segregator and Fill Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles waste management with a mechanical working mechanism and live object sorting demo that immediately grabs judges' attention.

ideas.pitch: A wearable patient monitoring wristband that tracks pulse rate, blood oxygen, and sudden falls, transmitting emergency alerts via local Wi-Fi to nurses.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation – Build anything innovative beyond the defined tracks
ideas.title: VitalEdge: Post-Operative Biometric IoT Telemetry Band
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements critical healthcare monitoring with dependable edge telemetry, mimicking award-winning biomedical IoT systems built under tight deadlines.
